# acecloud_volume (Resource)

Manages an Ace Cloud block storage volume.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the volume. Must be 3-100 characters, alphanumeric with hyphens and underscores only.
- `size` (Number) Size of the volume in GB. Must be between 8 and 16384 (16 TB).
- `volume_type` (String) Type of the volume (e.g. 'NVMe based High IOPS Storage').

### Optional

- `availability_zone` (String) Availability zone for the volume.
- `backup_id` (String) UUID of a backup to restore the volume from.
- `billing_type` (String) Billing type for the volume. Valid: hourly, monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, yearly. Defaults to 'hourly'.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the volume (0-255 characters). Only letters, numbers, underscores, hyphens, periods, commas, and spaces allowed.
- `image_ref` (String) UUID of an image to create a bootable volume from.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Key-value metadata pairs to associate with the volume.
- `snapshot_id` (String) UUID of a snapshot to create the volume from.
- `source_volid` (String) UUID of an existing volume to clone.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the volume.
- `status` (String) Current status of the volume (e.g. available, in-use).
